description:
Plan a loot room: which item categories go in which box, with each box's filter. The conveyor page's loot-room planner: each category needs (its item types x fill) slots; categories go biggest
first into the tightest box they fit, spilling across the emptiest boxes when none is big enough. Each box gets
the conveyor `filter_json` for its categories; `not_enough_room` says what didn't fit.

categories.description: Categories to store (default: everything but food, fun and attire).

fill_pct.description: How much of each category you'll keep, % of its item types.

name: plan_loot_room
title: Plan a loot room: which item categories go in which box, with each box's filter
